notes.title: Demo Live Now!! v0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that we will open the Demo for everyone for the whole month! Please don't forget to wishlist the game. Also Join us on OTK Games Expo TODAY!!

Updates:


 Fixed a bug where If player have selected employees but not clicking accept quest button and closes the quest UI instead. Next time they open the quest UI and try to assign employees, the employees previously selected will no longer appear on the employee selection UI as if the employees are already occupied. Trying replace an employee by reassigning the slot also has similar issue.
 Fxied a bug Accepting multiple quests ended up with only 1 quest is actually being done after clicking end turn. (there is only 1 battle despite I have accepted both quests in day 2)

notes.title: Update before the Demo live v0.0.7
notes.content:
Here are the following updates:

 Day 3 in total. 2 candidates each turn.,
 second and third turn will have 2 Quest each,
 New title screen bg
 New settings ui to handle resolution, fullscreen, volume,
 UI Dashboard to display multiple panel (e.g., Employee, Quest, Storage, Settings),
 New dialog for both Gramps and Advisor before initiating a quest,
 New dialog during the Financial report,
 Fix multiple bugs that been found during playtest # 1,
 Rebalancing gramps on quest turn 1.
 Improved UI Storage, Finance
 New UI Dashboard

notes.title: Updates for April 27, 2025 Build # 0.0.5
notes.content:
Build # 0.0.5

 Added "a candidate is waiting in line, ring the bell when you're ready" to Advisor Dialog
 Fixed where Popup will show when accepting quest without assigned employee.  
 Fixed Enemies portrait not working
 Fixed where Quest Button not working and Quest UI dissapeared when you select a unit in the Quest UI and close the Employee selection
 Added a popup when no quest was selected during the end turn.
 Fixed User could not proceed to battle without selecting a quest.
 Reduced Fungoid defense and increase attack power
 FPS display enabled
 Version number display enabled
